review_description: Fly-by-nighters were installing 6 years ago when SOLAR was all the rage (large rebates).Panels seem very good, Inverter was very good until it died after 5 years.

HiI have bought a solar system from enviromate victoria in December 2010 which was on 1/20 Arthur Street , Eltham, Victoria  and I now hear that they are liquidated. Now I have trouble with my panels (250W mono crystalline panels)and I really don't know how to get in touch as their phone contact is disconnected and their email is never replied to. I'm struggling to get my panels replaced and I do hope someone could help me solve this problem.
Very pleased with Enviromate.  Excellent installation, excellent response time.
The company and the installers were friendly, willing to answer any questions and were very efficient in all aspects of supplying information and follow up after the installation.

Robert Collings the Environmate Sales consultant was really good and helped with ensuring we were to get a fairly quick install.We paid deposit and signed for the system 31 Nov 2010Install was 10 Jan 2011Red ENERGY and SP Ausnet were great tooMeter fitted by SP Ausnet 28 Jan 2010

This field seems to be populated by ex-roof insulation companies.Nearly all are retail outlets, not the actual installers.All offered the best panels and inverters that China makes.Real information upon which to make an informed choice is hard to come by - Goverment Consumer Affairs would not provide list of dogdy dealers, the whirlpool internet site provided some good news stories but is short on facts, independant test results on panels and inverters are non-existent, CEC accreditation of panels and inverter are un-verifiable and rumor has it that installers can buy their way onto the CEC list. I even knocked on doors of some solar power installations around the area to get some idea of wether they were getting what was advertised (sold to them)I tried to contact 3 installers directly not they don't have time to give quotes or don't awswer their phones or return calls!I contacted 6 retailers; ranked here from bad to OK.1. Exel Power wanted to deal only with husband and wife. Advertising deal only2. AGL 11 x 185w panels $63743. Environment Shop 12 X 185W panels, $60954. Eko wanted $900 upfront to give a 'free' quote, 11 x 185W panels, $50995. Energyaware 11x190W panels, $4500 ($4300 for payment in full before installation)6. Environmate 9 x 230W panels $4170 ($3961 ditto)Installation dates were quoted by 5 and 6 were both 6-8 weeks after ordering ie mid JuneI selected Environmate based on price, a 10 year warranty and a local installation recommendation.Fewer larger panels suit my limited north facing roof space.Energyaware were ranked a very credible second.Note: 185W panels offered all appear to be copies of the Trina panel, (72 125 x 125mm cells) which is the only one with independant data available at the Desert Knowledge website.A sting in the tail is that my electricity retailer changes the smart meter tariff when I connect my grid connected solar power from a 24 hour peak rate (19 c/KwHr) to time of use one at 26 c/kWHr peak rate. But then they are paying me 68 c/kWHr net feed in tariff for my excess generation.It is a bit of worry that I was not able to get a clear answer from anyone on for how long the 68 cents will be paid for !!!I can not comment on 'Installation' and 'customer Service" are they havn't happened yet!I am not holding my breath for a good outcome for this project!

panel_brand: No idea what brand the panels are (Other)

review_description: As at today I am still waiting for installation so the question on installation standard etc not applicable.The company were quick to sell me the system and take my money off me but that's where their service stopped. Phone calls, email requests were not returned.  I am looking forward to a positive experience but Enviromate customer service is pathetic.
Although the supplier was incredibly busy at the time. They had to be chased a few times to finalise the contract resulting in a visit to their office.(Brighton to Eltham).

Enviromate sent me a SMS within 24 hours and were in touch 2 days later with a quote. Very friendly and helpful also price was about $1500.00 cheaper than my other quote.Broady Electrictical sent me an email with a quote 2 weeks later and the third one I never heard from

The time between signing up for a system and installation was longer than expected and there wasn't much communication from Enviromate.  I had to chase them on the phone and via email but eventually the installer booked me in for installation.  It was about 12 weeks.(I had a 2.5kw system installed btw.. your drop down menu didn't let me choose that)
some places did not even bother responding to online quotes they give me.
Enviromate were the 1st to respond and were the cheapest.

As the salesman is not the actual installer (of course) they are not always aware of everything that might be required upon installation thus we were hit with an additional $100.00 bill on the day of installation for a switch.  You can't exactly say no on the day can you... but it would have been nice to know up front.  Whilst the salesman obviously knew the product well, he obviously knew nothing about installation, in which case I would have preferred he told me nothing about the installation side of things and suggested a $100 - $200 buffer for unforseen costs.
The sales person was very thorough when  explaining system. Not pushy.More confident to go with local based company

I went with one of the installers that you found for me. I am unsure of the name of the sytem, I do not know if it is from Enviromate. But I can say that I was very happy with the person that I chose he had my system installed in 17 days from when I ordered it. My system is fully operational now as the electricity company finally put in the new meter last week. I am completely happy with the service that you provided, it made the whole experience so much easier than I had anticipated. I had been putting it off for quite some time dreading all the running around, so many people had different idea's. My installers business name is Gippsland V.G Electrical & Solar, his name is Vlado Gasper and I would recommend him any time.

Everything was explained to us and the reality of the situation in that our roof is not perfectly aligned to get the most sun and also in Winter to not expect great output.  In the Summer we achieved 29Kwh on one day and generally in the 20's on the nice sunny days.  Now that we are in Winter with cloud cover all day we still achieve some output - we got 1Kwh on an absolutely miserable day.  We also put a Future Wave Energy Saver on our pool pump which reduced the pumps's power usage by half.

Enviromate contacted me within one day of receiving my request for quotation and were very flexible and made very valuable suggestions on how to proceed.I installed 4kw solar PV and also Solar hot water. Hot water system installed within two weeks of agreeing to proceed. Solar power took longer due to lack of supply of 5kw inverters.When the system was installed it was done within one day (24 panels and a 5kw inverter)Enviromate did a very good job on both installations.I did have problems with electricity supply and distribution companies as they took 3 months to provide a feed in meter. They between them lost all of my paperwork 3 times. Then they changed the forms required so we had to resubmit on the new forms. It would appear that the only way to get the power companies to act on your behalf is to continually contact them to request info on progress. make sure that you ask for estimated dates and keep on checking to ensure progressDuring recent hail storms my panels survived. My daughter has installed a similar setup with Enviromate two days before the hail storm, she suffered damage to her house and car but all panels survived the stormI wanted to know how well the system was working by providing method to have readings available in the house. Enviromate was able to provide a Wattson Energy meter that can read the power used and generated. You can get readings directly on the meter but even better it allows you to connect to a computer so that you can see usage graphs on power used and generated

Enviromate offered a personalised service to help match the solar system to my household needs.They arranged a home visit to evaluate my roof direction and suitability, then gave me several options, based on rising cost of power, my budget and future upgrades. The warranty provided was the best available, and this helped secure the deal for me.  Piece of mind!Enviromate was a refreshing experience!

After a long and drawn out investigation process I decided to go with Enviromate. From my research they had a better system at a price I was happy with. They were very helpful with all my questions which were very basic to a little more technical in regards to monitoring the system via a data link to my PC. After placing the order I had to wait two and a half months for the install but in the end I got the Solivia inverter and the panels were updated to Infinity 245Watt panels which are better panels than I had ordered. At this stage I am waiting for the system to be turned on.In all the installation took a lot longer than I had expected but the hard part is over and thus far I am satisfied.

Environmate had an excellent salesperson who followed up my initial interest quickly and was very patient in answering my many questions. The system was installed within 3 weeks. However, there was disagreement between the salesperson and the installer as to which part of the roof would provide the best result. The salesperson suddenly left the company and I just had to take the word of the installer.
Still waiting to be connected to the grid.

Value for Money and Quality of System cannot be properly judged at this time.Enviromate had a cancellation and they installed the day they contacted us and it took less than a day.  Excellent experience.The inspection found a wiring fault which was fixed immediately.The meter was re-configured today (22/5) and hopefully everything now works to our advantage.
They were very professional, flexible with us when it came install time. The price between my known brand system and less reputable system's not significant enough to chance buying a lemon.

I was quoted a price, but the installers were able to reconfigure the layout. It looked better and it cost me $500.00 dollars less. Enviromate had the $500.00 refunded to my credit card, the same day as they were notified of the installation. Absolutely, no hesitation. Fantastic.

Quoted 6 to 8 weeks to install, but was installed within a week of signing. Reasonable price, not the cheapest nor the dearest and were willing to negotiate price. Salesman bent over backwards to get our business. The system is up and running better than I expected. Well done Enviromate.

Our sales representative was fantastic, he went out of his way to answer all of our questions and replied to endless e-mails that I sent.  He made us feel very comfortable with the investment we were making because he knew the product so well and answered all of our questions with confidence and knowledge.  Installation was quick and professional and head office were very polite.

When installers arrived I found out the meter board had to have an upgrade as it still had the old fuses, not circuit breakers. The sales rep who checked the site for my quote did not mention this. Would have thought he'd have known that the board had to have circuit breakers installed. Added to the overall cost of job. Very happy with the installation, very professional. Job was completed within 3 weeks of the quote.Deposit payed 20th January. Job completed 9th February. Job inspected, passed, and paperwork sent to Origin Energy 16th February.Already had a smart meter installed, and the Powercor tech arrived and reprogrammed the meter beginning of March.All in all I have no hesitation in recommending Enviromate, and the price was right, too.

I was looking for someone to install solar in the month before the state premium tariff of 66c/kw was due to end.  Geoff from Enviromate was great - he rang us as soon as he heard that the tariff was ending, booked us in, promised us installation within the fortnight and delivered on his promise.  I was very nervous, having read about Enviromate on a blog that was highly critical, but our experience was quite the reverse.  Promises that were made were filled and I am entirely confident in the system that is now on our roof and working!

I pointed out to the supplier that the contractor who installed normally used a Melb inspector and as I am in the country there could be a delay -Within 5 days a local inspector arrived.Am most grateful for being introduced to Environmate.
Enviromate were extremely difficult to deal with. Once they had our deposit we didn't hear from them until we started to chase them and ring every day to get some action for re installment.
Since the system is yet to be installed, it is difficult to comment on service or quality of system.
They seem to be very well updated with solar panels and the inverters they new what they were talking about .
They are a bit hard to get in contact with. Phone calls not returned which leads to not knowing if order is going forward or not.

Your advice regarding the questions to ask and things to consider was wonderful. And included things that we had not a clue about.  One or two of the questions were new to the salesperson, so he too was grateful.  Thank you for your assistance.

Still waiting for installaton but was told before putting down deposit that it would be early to mid June and now its almost May. Only thing haven't got a confirmed date yet. Great price and quality system

Some companies don't want to listen to what you want, they just want to push higher priced systems. Other sales people think it's a chore to come out and give a quote. I think in this area the better the sales person ( by being friendly and informative) the more chance they have of getting the job as it is an area that little is known about by the general public and the customer is relying on honest information being fed to them.

The company installed the panels after 3 months of payment, which was specified. It took another 6 weeks to install the inverter and only I made numerous phone calls to find out what happened. The level of service was poor, no one seemed to know who was responsible. After the system was installed I was contacted and asked if I would like to receive an upgrade to a better system for no extra cost. When I informed them that they had installed a system they took back the offer of an upgrade.The installer was very good but he was a contractor from another company.Enviromate seemed very disorganised.

We decided to pay up front to receive further discounts, BIG MISTAKE!!! They told us about 12 weeks from ordering, our system would be on our roof.  It took 19 weeks, and I'm convinced that is only because I rang them every single day enquiring about our installation that we got it that soon. They got a local contractor to install it for them anyway. They always promised to return phone calls, but once we had paid we never heard from them, no phone calls, no emails. It actually made me feel sick! My mum had her solar system installed by a local guy, paid her deposit, four and a half weeks later she had her system on the roof. There is no way I would recommend Enviromate after our experience.

I went with the Enviromate because the salesman was interested in my questions and always apologized if he couldn't immediately do something. He was also the only company to show me the workmanship of an install so I could see the results.  The company also offers a 10 year warranty on workmanship, install, and the inverter up front with 25 years on the panel with a direct swap out if a problem arises not a return to manufacturer.
I bought two systems for two different properties and at this point only the one has been installed but not yet connected to the grid, only time will tell what savings are made.

Hi Finn,The total cost of the choosen 1500w solar power generator is $  2870.00. I have paid $ 700.00 deposit and signed the contract. They sent me the invoice no. 00001736 on 17/11/2010. They told me the job will be finished in about 10 weeks. Today is the 8th of march 2011. Two weeks ago I phoned them and asked them to tell me when they are going to install it because I have to travel interstate soon. They told me they'll look into it. After that, up to now, they did not answer my question. very diapointed.. thanks   Finn
The sales man "Matt" from Enviromate  was the Nicest Salesperson I  have come across in a long time ...he was very helpful.

Just finding out what the different panels and controllers were all about was a one off experience I found difficult. Different suppliers were pushing their products and I had to go to Choice (good site) and Google to get information.Three other people/friends are now going with the supplier I chose as they provide quick and clear quotes as well as being competitively priced.

One installer did a site inspection and tried to talk me out of investing in solar power. The volume of choices of installers and systems is a bit overwhelming. If you know what you want a good deal can be nailed down.

We paid the deposit just before Christmas. Was advised installation will be on mid January. Now it is Feb the 12th still nothing and heard nothing from them. Did enquire mid Jan and was advised 8 to 10 weeks from date of deposit. Person on the other end of the phone very rude. Just goes to show once they have your deposit NOTHING.
One supplier didn't even want to quote as they thought it would be a waste of time getting a system, based on near map photo at 7am in winter. All other photos had full sun!!
I'll leave that till after installatin in mid-Feb 2011
The solar panels have not been installed yet.

Although the sales contact person had problems accessing his message bank, he did do all that was asked and was clearly knowledgeable in the business. The contracted installer arrived when he said he would, he was extremely professional with his business and followed up as promised.I have no hesitation in recommending this company, but still recommend research before committing to any potential purchasers.
Well I didn't get a reciept for my payment up front, which is a worry, I hope that it is actually installed in due course.

Enviromate is a great company.  The salesman was very helpful in guiding us to the right system and more than great compared to a competitor's price.  Although we waited for our panels to arrive in Australia, the system was installed for only a day when it did arrived.  As a retired tradesman I can tell you that it was a perfect job - everything was straight and neat.  If you are all worried about choosing a solar system or whom to go with, you won't regret going down the Enviromate path like we did.
I Purchased a 2.5 Kw system. The questinnaire dd not have an option for this. Can this be added to the list of system sizea?

I asked for 3 quotes but only received 1 but the response I received was from Enviromate. I have good feedback from David and we organized for a quote which was quite reasonable. I had my solar installed after 6 weeks which was great after being told it would be 8 to 10 weeks. I'm just waiting for the system to be put online now by the power company for the meter to be reset or changed.

There is limited information as to what occurs post-contract - I am having to chase up the supplier prior to installation to ascertain what steps will be undrtaken, and what timeline, in getting the system fully operational.They also came up with a special price post Christmas, lower than the amount I paid (in full, up front) prior to Christmas - there was no effort to contact me re this and offer the lower rate prior to installation. Presumably, they allowed me to pay this higher rate in December 2010 knowing they would be offering a lower price for new customers in early 2011. Not an honorable way to do business.
I found that as any sales person would is to try and upgrade from the basic system. My choice was based on the being able to pay on installment.

I have found that a lot of companies talk in there jargon that is not always easy to understand. It can be quiet confusing trying to compare as they can make it sound like an apple versus orange, and try to sell you a bigger unit doing it this way.
They were helpful. They gave comprehensive information regards all aspects of solar power, most of which I knew little about.
Positive so far! Waiting for installation in January ...

They originally quoted us a 10-12 week wait until the system was installed and said it would probably be 12 weeks as the 10 weeks fell at christmas/new year. That put installation in Jan 2011.The system was actually installed today (10/12/10) after 7 weeks which was fantastic.
AGL  phoned today to advise us that they will be here soon to adjust the "smart meter"
They have kept me informed throughout.
enviromate  keep in touch . i beleaf it  is important

The quotes I received via solarquotes were all good, but different. I also visited a local show room.Origin also have a good deal (cheap) but provide no presales advice.The problem I have is that the quotes varied in price by $2,000 for the same installation, and I hope that the difference is not in the quality of the installation.I also have no idea when the installation will be done not to mention when the power company will do the final connection.The industry seems similar to the roof insulation companies in 2009.
Best price, but have to wait 4-6 weeks to have it instaled.
I had to continually call Enviromate to find out when my system would be installed. The salesman advised that the system would be installed in 6 weeks and it took 3 months.
Excellent customer engagement thus far. Responded promptly to many questions re the system.
The other two suppliers were not in the race, one was $1500 dearer and only sent an email nothing else was heard from him and the other one didnt even bother to contact me at all
The system isn't installed as yet. Solar suppliers are incredibly slow to install and set up. Minimum 10 weeks from sign up.

There was a long delay between our ordering and paying up front for the system and the actual installation.  We paid in late June but installation was not completed until late September. Apart from the wait there customer service was very good.
signed up 7 weeks ago but still waiting for installation

Installation is yet to occur so it is hard to sing praises of system chosen and installation efficiency yet but was impressed by professionalism of salesperson and the Enviromate organisation.Will be happy to give feedback when it all happens.

Enviromate were really helpfull with their advice. The salesman was friendly and patient and kept in contact with us while we were getting other quotes. Any questions we had were answered immediately and we had no problems ringing through to them as they answered the phones straight away and did not have us on hold or have us waiting for a call back from them. We are really looking forward to the installation, hopefully in a few weeks.

We close the deal on the 14th July 2010, with very strict instruction to get the money on my Bank account after two weeks so as to have my funds on that day. But this didn't happen, they took the money on the 15th July 2010 which is the following day. I am going to suffer the consiquence in my Bank for over drawing fund.Completion date: I've been told from 6 to 8 weeks, untill now I haven't recieved any information from them of progress status, inspite of all emails i've sent.Still waiting for their response back when will this installation going to happen. its  7 weeks now.

After speaking with the sales rep of the company and negotiated a deal my family bought 2 additional systems from them and hopefully they should all be all installed by mid November. That means that Enviromate Australia Pty Ltd sold my family a total of 3 solar systems.My wife and I are at present caravaning in N.S.W. and hope to be home mid November at which time I will probally get in contact with them to discuss the hot water installation.Thanks for your service I am very impressed that you do this from Adelaide and help Victorian company's.Clyde McGinnesGeelong
We would recommend getting a few different quotes from different people as they all vary in prices and quality systems.

This feedback is on a system up-grade (not yet installed).  This Enviromate gave a better quote than my original installer and were more informative on supposed benefits of the feed in tarriff.But I still have major concerns with the electricity supplier deal.  HOW CAN PEAK TIME BE 6AM TO 11PM?  THEY CLAIM I AM NOT PAYING FOR THE METER, YET THE DAILY CONNECTION FEE HAS INCREASED AROUND 50%.I enjoyed seeing the meter turning backwards, now mid winter I have only gtenertated 4 or 5 megawatts in a week and used 60 odd.
We haven't installed our system yet as our house is still being built, but so far Enviromate have been very helpful and the cheapest quote we could find for such a good system by far.

Just waiting for the system to be installed. Salesperson was excellent and explained all aspects of the system to us. Thanks for your help in getting quotes. Although you could only get one in our area its the one we chose. Did get quotes from 3 or 4 others.
enviromate contacted me within 30 mins of requesting a quote, they were very helpful and informativeThe panels were installed within 6 to 8 weeks. Highly recomend this company.alan bissett.
The sales person dose not reply to phone calls or emails. Its hard to get the company to reply as well.
IT DID NOT GET INSTALLED PROMPTLY- 3MONTH LATE
i am just waiting for the meter to be installed but i can recommend enviromate for their service. as they were the only ones to reply to my inquiry.they are very courteous and attentive.
I found that the other people you recommended did not respond to my enquiry, even though they are Bendigo based. (musnt want to sell them!!)

I have had my system on 2wks a few days have been the perfect enviroment not a cloud 19degrees 2-3pm the best output was 1.5kw from a 2.5kw system i generated 5kwh for the day. I no this is the worst time for generation but it is disappointing i expected better.
Very helpful, especially with sorting out my energy retailer who wee a real pain.

I cannot answer whether we have received value for money or what the quality of our system because I really don`t know. We have not had a new meter installed as yet - we are waiting for our supplier AGL to come and put one in, also I have not had bill as yet but anything less that the $421.55 bill I received for the last quater has to be a good thing!!!
purchase to install, 6 months. install to gov inspection 1 month. still not hooked up to the grid, 3 months later. you have to be patient.

I have rated my system as 4 for value for money purely on the basis of comparison with other companies.Whether the  overall value for money of solar over regular electricity will rate higher or lower will take time to evaluate.I am in the process (two weeks after installation) of comparing quotes from the various electricity suppliers and find myself quite confused by the great difficulty in comparing apples with apples.I was quite shocked to discover that my present supplier (Red Energy) has a much higher rate for supply of my electricity needs now that I have gone to solar and that Tru Energy and Origin were the same.  I guess that you can't win against the big boys!The charge per kWh during peak time (3pm-11pm in Summer) is double what I am paying now.The only mitigating factor is the low off-peak rate offered  by Red Energy for weekends and public holidays.The other companies have a flat rate of 7c/kWh above what I am paying at present.  My decision is a work in progress which is further complicated by the fact that if I agree to Red Energy installing my solar meter, I am tied into a 24 month contract. I should appreciate hearing of other peoples's experiences in this regard.

At this stage I can't put a value for money and quality of system rating, I expect (hope) they will be average or above average but time will tell, our system is in place only a few weeks and we are still waiting for our Electricity Supplier to install a smart meter.Thanks very much for your service it provided good guidance in this field
For the price I payed, the system does not generate enough power on low sunlight days. I was told that 8 hours of light generate 6+ kw but I was not told about how strong the light needed to be.

Our system was installed in January 2010 so it is a bit early to rate the value for money or quality of the system - in time these factors will become clearer.  We found the experience very daunting and like others found that it is such a new industry it is difficult to find friends or acquaintances from which to draw experiences from.  Some of the processes are in their infancy and are largely untested.  We felt there could have been better communication between the supplier - ourselves - our energy provider.  To date we have seen very little financial benefit as we were not told we needed to sign a 'Premium Feed In Tariff Contract' and to date have not received any benefit from sending power back to the grid.

They made it very easy from start to finish.The installers were fantastic, they even cleaned up after themselves which sadly, is a rare thing these days, they explained everything, could not fault them.

Enviromate, AGL (my retailer) and the Ombudsman's Office were all most helpful.But SP AUSNET were hopeless. Smart meter only installed on 29/05/2010 more than 3 months after solar panels.They claimed a strike in China had delayed the meters,but magically installed a meter two days after I complained to the Energy  Ombudsman.
I still am having troubles with getting a smart meter after after 6 months.It took over 4 months to get the system installed
the one is letting me down are Jemena and Agl , they are making delays after delays , after four months still not conected to the grid.

We had a little problem with Enviromate as the 14 panels that I was quoted for on installation did not fit the space on the roof.In the end I added the panels not only to my north facing roof but to a pergola that is north facing. The installers who are not employed by Enviromate were not very happy, when they arrived and discovered this.But in saying this they were a great team and overcame the problems.I think perhaps the biggest problem of the suppliers is they just sell and don't have any input into the installation process.Environmate to me seemed the more geniune of the companies. There were those who I would of  had to pay to came out to receive  just a quote and State Solar Services seemed to just want to sell the 1.5kw system because it was the cheapest regardless that we may not set me up for the future.
